name: go-design-patterns
description: > Idiomatic Go design patterns: functional options, builder, factory, strategy, middleware chain, pub/sub, and other patterns adapted for Go's type system. Use when: "design pattern", "functional options", "builder pattern", "factory pattern", "strategy pattern", "middleware chain", "option pattern", "how to structure this". Not for: interface design (go-interface-design), package layout (go-architecture-review), concurrency patterns (go-concurrency-review).
author: eduardo-sl
summary_zh: 一套面向 Go 的惯用设计模式实践，帮助你选择合适的代码组织方式，解决复杂模块的结构设计问题。
